method: Faithful digest/within-band draw for five fresh easy batch candidates, including exclusions. Positive easy weights renormalize to easy when no other band is supplied. Candidates are ordered by assigned stable indices for this read-only hypothetical pool, not claimed database entity IDs.
conclusion: Any selected generated easy member retains shortest-option cue. In a mixed inventory selection can choose original/easy or other difficulties; no claim that every question in the whole learner pool is shortcut-answerable.
limits: Actual learner histories, task seeds and active policy weights not supplied; no realized learner sequence claimed.
No publication or database mutations. Captured inventory may later change.
